brief_feedback: All three assigned source images were viewed exactly once, whole first and then each half. Thirty unresolved local regions were frozen before cropping; one crop per region was made through work/scripts/crop.py and every crop was displayed once. No OCR, recognition library, external source, other-page image, other reader output, or compilation was used. Inventory covers all 30 page entries, continuation blocks, date, divider, nested underlining/deletions, marginal cluster and retained isolated marks. H has description-only status, so no H textual collation rows are manufactured. The page supplies correction fragments and an undefined cancelled expression, not an evaluable mathematical assertion; no mathematical verification event is claimed.
